skills.name: of-case-start
skills.title: Start an investigation
skills.description: Scope an authorized OSINT or forensic investigation and create a private portable case. Use for starting an enquiry, case setup or selected evidence intake; not for bulk collection or live acquisition.

skills.name: of-source-provenance
skills.title: Check source provenance
skills.description: Check publication origins, recycled reporting and source independence. Use for corroboration, source verification or identifying articles that repeat one origin; not for automatic credibility scores.

skills.name: of-hypothesis-audit
skills.title: Audit competing hypotheses
skills.description: Audit alternative explanations, confirmation bias and contradictions in investigation evidence. Use for competing-hypothesis review or hypothesis review; not for treating model consensus as independent confirmation.

skills.name: of-domain-infrastructure
skills.title: Investigate domain infrastructure
skills.description: Interpret public DNS/RDAP and certificate captures for a scoped OSINT question. Use for domain investigation or DNS analysis; not for active scans, exploit testing, user enumeration or attribution from shared hosting.

skills.name: of-geolocation
skills.title: Review geolocation hypotheses
skills.description: Test location hypotheses from authorized public-place imagery and contextual evidence. Use for geolocation or image geolocation; not for biometrics, stalking or disclosing a private person's sensitive whereabouts.

skills.name: of-media-forensics
skills.title: Triage media evidence
skills.description: Inspect media provenance, supplied metadata and visible inconsistencies. Use for image/video verification, EXIF review or image analysis; not for guaranteed AI detection or an authenticity verdict from absent metadata.

skills.name: of-document-triage
skills.title: Triage documents and files
skills.description: Triage selected files, archives, documents and exported email headers while preserving originals. Use for document forensics or file triage; not for macros, malware execution, unknown-archive extraction or treating sender headers as verified identity.

skills.name: of-browser-artifacts
skills.title: Analyze browser history copies
skills.description: Analyze explicitly supplied Chromium or Firefox SQLite history copies. Use for browser forensics or browsing history; not for live profile collection, cookies, passwords or inferring user intent from recorded URLs.

skills.name: of-log-timeline
skills.title: Build an evidence timeline
skills.description: Build evidence-linked timelines from JSON, JSONL or CSV exports while preserving timestamp uncertainty. Use for incident timelines or log analysis; not for live production collection or binary EVTX parsing.

skills.name: of-evidence-correlate
skills.title: Correlate case evidence
skills.description: Review candidate timestamp or URL relationships between evidence-linked event analyses. Use for artifact correlation or combining OSINT and forensic events; not for automatic identity matching or causal attribution.

skills.name: of-investigation-report
skills.title: Write an investigation report
skills.description: Write a private report distinguishing evidence-supported observations, inferences and unknowns. Use for OSINT reports, forensic findings or analyst handoff; not for legal certification or summaries hiding unsupported claims.

skills.name: of-case-export
skills.title: Export or resume a case
skills.description: Export verified private cases, resume investigations or prepare a digest-bound public view. Use for case handoff or investigation sharing; not for automatic publication, uploads or treating masking as anonymization.
